rule_outs: Dwelling 8 m from the best section
summary: Quiet suburban kerb with cars parked, homes about 10 m away on this side.
reasons: Homes 10-12 m from kerb, same side

drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street; cars park on the opposite kerb, so a van fits along this side.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street, little through traffic likely.
drivers.convention: Parked cars line the street, so a van is not out of place.

flags: Dwellings about 10 m from the kerb
sun_shade: Open to morning sun from the east; large tree canopy on the west side shades the north end in the afternoon.

best_section.where: Murray Street east kerb, about 20 m north of the corner, before the row of houses
